propositions: A Pass-1 code-review overlay must be authored in code-review-concurrency.md to flag correctness races (unlocked-twin accessors bypassing sibling serialization discipline) that are not covered by the security or performance overlays.

The rubric must enforce a lockset-first quartet bright-line: shared mutable resource name, ≥2 concurrent executors with spawn/entry-point citations, interleaving window with quoted read+write, and concrete harm (not just 'behaves unexpectedly').

The rubric must include disposition-aware guard suppression: only suppress when the guard prevents the harm; defer attacker-controlled TOCTOU to 'security' and load-only concurrency to 'performance' by name.

The prompt file must declare frontmatter keys (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt), instruct criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and state that empty findings are expected.
Registration (OVERLAY_IDS entry, routing, dispatch wiring) is deferred to dependent story errable-tricksome-ape; this story delivers the inert prompt document only.
Structural validation (frontmatter parsing, rubric section presence, criteria declaration) is verified by grep; behavioral validation is owned by standing eval story ironfisted-humble-shrew.
